description: Change a dataset the account owns: title, language, tools, required capabilities or default scenario. Names the configVersion it read; a newer one is VERSION_CONFLICT. A published set keeps serving its published config until atlas_dataset_publish. Needs a signed-in inite.ai account: a guest call answers 401 and starts the OAuth flow.

idempotencyKey.description: Any unique string per intended change (8-128 chars). A retry with the same key and body returns the first answer.

name: atlas_dataset_update
title: Change a dataset
